page: Amazon Web Services c8gb.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs running at 2.8 GHz, with no hyperthreading. The memory configuration consists of 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. This instance operates on the Nitro hypervisor and utilizes an arm64 architecture. It includes 100 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, but does not feature local storage or GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with large block read and write speeds placing in the top 10%. Multi-core processing capabilities are strong, as demonstrated by top-tier Geekbench multi-core and software compilation scores. Database operations and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 10%. Single-core performance and cryptographic operations fall within the average range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated ARMv9 core allocation and high memory bandwidth provide dense resource utilization for multi-threaded workloads without the overhead of hyperthreading. This server is suited for software compilation, static web serving, database operations, and multi-threaded decompression tasks. It is also capable of handling medium to large LLM text generation workloads.
